tool_schemas.name: general_search
tool_schemas.description: Searches Bilibili with the provided keyword and returns the raw upstream search response as a dictionary; results are not normalized or filtered by this endpoint. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when keyword is missing or empty, UNAUTHORIZED when the caller’s API key is missing/invalid/disabled, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the client exceeds rate or quota limits. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when the Bilibili upstream request fails or times out.

tool_schemas.name: search_user
tool_schemas.description: Searches Bilibili users by keyword and page (1-based) and returns a dictionary of user search results for that page as provided by the upstream API. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when keyword is missing/empty or page is not a positive integer, UNAUTHORIZED when the caller’s API key is missing/invalid/disabled, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the client exceeds rate or quota limits. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when the upstream Bilibili user search request fails or times out.

tool_schemas.name: get_precise_results
tool_schemas.description: Performs a typed search for the given keyword and search_type (user/video/live/article) and returns a normalized, filtered result set containing only exact matches according to our precise-filtering rules. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when keyword is missing/empty or search_type is not one of user, video, live, article; also raises UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid/disabled API keys and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the client exceeds rate or quota limits. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when the upstream search request fails or times out.

tool_schemas.name: get_video_danmaku
tool_schemas.description: Fetches danmaku for the given BV id, returning the cached danmaku payload when available or fetching from upstream and caching it for subsequent requests. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when bv_id is missing/empty or not in a recognized BV format, UNAUTHORIZED when the caller’s API key is missing/invalid/disabled, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the client exceeds rate or quota limits. Raises NOT_FOUND when the BV id does not resolve to a video or has no danmaku available, and UPSTREAM_ERROR when the upstream danmaku fetch fails or times out.

tool_schemas.name: whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated API client identity for the presented API key, including status, granted scopes (if any), and current quota / rate-limit consumption. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED when the API key is missing or invalid, FORBIDDEN when the client is not active (suspended/revoked), and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the client exceeds rate or quota limits.

api_key.description: Caller API key presented to authenticate this request.

tool_schemas.name: list_search_queries
tool_schemas.description: Lists recorded search query jobs for the authenticated client with optional filtering by status/search_type and cursor pagination. Returns a page of search_queries rows (metadata only) sorted by created_at descending. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid/disabled API keys, FORBIDDEN when the client is not active, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the client exceeds rate or quota limits.

api_key.description: Caller API key used to authenticate and attribute results.

status.description: Filter by search query lifecycle status.

keyword.description: Optional substring filter on the original keyword.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned from a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: get_search_query
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single search query job by id for the authenticated client, including its status, cache fields, and timestamps. Refuses NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist for the caller, UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid/disabled API keys, FORBIDDEN when the client is not active, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the client exceeds rate or quota limits.

api_key.description: Caller API key used to authenticate and authorize access.

id.description: Primary key of the search_queries row.

tool_schemas.name: list_search_results
tool_schemas.description: Lists normalized search_results for a given query_id owned by the authenticated client, with optional filtering by result_type and exact_match. Returns results ordered by rank ascending. Refuses NOT_FOUND if the query_id does not exist for the caller, UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid/disabled API keys, FORBIDDEN when the client is not active, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the client exceeds rate or quota limits.

api_key.description: Caller API key used to authenticate and authorize access.

exact_match.description: When set, filters results by exact_match flag.

limit.description: Maximum number of result rows to return.

offset.description: Zero-based offset into the result set.

tool_schemas.name: list_danmaku_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists danmaku fetch jobs for the authenticated client with optional filtering by status and bv_id. Returns a page of danmaku_requests rows sorted by created_at descending. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid/disabled API keys, FORBIDDEN when the client is not active, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the client exceeds rate or quota limits.

api_key.description: Caller API key used to authenticate and attribute results.

status.description: Filter by danmaku request lifecycle status.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned from a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: update_danmaku_response_status
tool_schemas.description: Transitions a cached danmaku response lifecycle state for the given response id (fresh/stale/purged) to control cache behavior. Only allows valid state transitions (fresh→stale|purged, stale→fresh|purged) and refuses INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION otherwise. Refuses NOT_FOUND if the response id does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid/disabled API keys, FORBIDDEN when the client is not active, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the client exceeds rate or quota limits.

api_key.description: Caller API key used to authenticate and authorize this operation.

id.description: Primary key of the danmaku_responses row.

status.description: Target lifecycle status for the danmaku response.

metadata.name: Bilibili API Server
metadata.description: This backend powers an API server that proxies Bilibili search and danmaku endpoints while adding caching, normalization (precise filtering), and operational controls. It stores API clients (keys), search queries with typed results (user/video/live/article), and danmaku fetch jobs plus cached danmak
